[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Thomas Glasgow was born about 1766 and died in 1851. He was the son of [[Glasgow-1023|Thomas Glasgow]] and [[Mill-357|Janet Mill]].<ref>FamilySearch. https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1RG-JFP (accessed 2025).</ref><ref>BillionGraves. https://billiongraves.com/grave/Thomas-Glasgow/3399144 (accessed 2025).</ref>

Recorded 1746 child and Thomas/Janet Mill household98%; this does not prove every later Thomas identity or the father’s own Kilwinning childhood. Original uninspected.
